answer: Vest rewards slowly: each agent's earnings unlock along a long schedule, and any unvested balance is clawed back if peers later prove it shared keys or answers with others. A sybil farm is like a knoll of fresh timber piled at an inlet, worth nothing until it dries for months. The attacker must keep every fake identity honest and funded through the whole vesting window, so mass-spawning accounts buys only frozen, revocable tokens.
